lineage.summary: Community identifies the three sticker marks on the advertised hidden-clue cover, compares their arrangement with the secret-ending lever, proposes entering the ordered CE symbols into the lever, and proposes printed copy number as the likely order.
The same idea is restated explicitly as dot-left, dash-right, slash-top matching lever left/right/up.

historical_claim.community_hypothesis: The Collector's Edition sticker foreground symbols may encode inputs for the three-position secret-ending lever.

epistemic_status.mapping: historically attested, independently motivated by an in-world/packaging clue; source images should remain separately inspectable
epistemic_status.normal_code_replay: Structurally closed by Experiment 343: the 81/27 alphabets make every contiguous forward/reverse/rotated placement of the normal 14-command bunker password impossible regardless of unknown cells.
epistemic_status.serial_order: Printed copy number is physical evidence; using ascending copy number as lever-command order is historically attested community inference, not an explicit developer instruction.

experiment_343.consequence: The weak five-observation cyclic hit from Experiment 342 is closed once directly observed zone alphabets are enforced.
